fusions.name: Squall Ripple
fusions.desc: Pulses arcane force that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you; you move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Spellbound Ballista
fusions.desc: Fires an arcane bolt at an enemy up to 9 tiles away; it deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Sails Full of Mana
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Arcane Ballast
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
